title: Customer Activation Staircase: staged enablement and release-note choreography
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Goal: Build an operationalized, repeatable play for activating high-touch lighthouse customers and a scalable lightweight path for the next 100 beta customers. Deliver a staged enablement plan, one coherent release-notes choreography for cross-channel comms, and a closed-loop feedback process that ties signals to success criteria and product improvements.

Scope and deliverables:
- Staged enablement map (Stage 0: internal validation -> Stage 1: 5 lighthouse customers -> Stage 2: 50 beta customers -> Stage 3: open beta). Includes preflight checklist, dependencies, and rollback criteria.
- Release-note choreography doc: canonical content pack (what changed, impact, migration notes, example prompts, known limitations), template for PM/Eng/Docs sign-off, and timeline for email, console banner, in-app help, and private customer notes.
- Cross-team cadence: weekly triage for incoming bugs, bi-weekly GTM review with sales/CS, and a single source of truth in Confluence for launch artifacts.
- Feedback loop: structured prompt/eval sets, telemetry dashboard slices, NPS micro-survey for lighthouse cohort, and escalation paths for regressions.
- Success criteria: onboarding time < 3 days for lighthouse flows, < 5% critical bug rate in first 14 days, engagement benchmark (tokens/session) target, and verified migration of at least 3 production use-cases per lighthouse customer.

Stakeholders: PM (Aisha), Eng leads (runtime and console), Design (UX for onboarding flows), Docs, Sales/CS for lighthouse orchestration, Solutions Engineers for technical enablement, Security for compliance sign-off.

Acceptance gates (must pass all to proceed to wider beta):
1) End-to-end verification runbook for customer onboarding completed and tested with internal account.
2) Release notes signed by PM, Tech Writer, and Eng on-call with link to migration examples.
3) Observability: dashboards created, alerts configured, and runbook for common regressions documented.
4) CS playbook and handoff checklist validated with at least two SE dry-runs.

Risks and trade-offs:
- Rolling out earlier can accelerate feedback but increases blast radius; mitigations include feature flags and per-account traffic limiting.
- Tight release-note cadence may require frozen PR windows; mitigations include asynchronous channels for late-breaking patches.

Key links and artifacts (canonical):
- Confluence: Customer Activation Staircase (doc) - https://company.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/PM/pages/CA-Activation
- Release notes template: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/ReleaseNotes/Templates
- Onboarding runbook (GDrive): https://drive.google.com/onboarding/runbook
- GitHub staging PRs: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pulls?q=is%3Apr+label%3Alaunch
- Dashboards: Grafana: /d/launch-readiness/customer-activation-staircase

Next steps:
- Finalize release-note templates and sign-off matrix (owner: Tech Writer).
- Schedule two SE dry-runs with the CS team before 2026-03-20.
- Lock the initial lighthouse list and run preflight with one internal sandbox account by 2026-03-24.
